segments.title: Chương 137: Game và đứng hát trên Xiaonei, sao cậu thắng nổi tôi?
segments.content:
Two consecutive periods, the lecture was over in 90 minutes.

Chen Guiliang had just stood up, planning to go to the company to discuss things with Ao Yanchen, when Senior Brother Long Xiang sent a text, right on cue.

"Go to Director Zhu's office. You've failed a few too many courses."

"Alright."

He had just finished Professor Zhu's lecture, and now he had to report to Director Zhu.

He wouldn't be expelled, would he?

Pedaling his bicycle, Chen Guiliang soon met with Director Zhu.

"Have a seat."

All the sacred mountains, great rivers, trees, and buildings shattered at this moment, sucked into that enormous pillar, which then increased its weight to the extreme.

The second outcome was to successfully evade the teleportation thunderstorms, but after three days, they would be influenced by the aura of the ancient gods and demons, lose their sense of self, and cultivators would slaughter one another. They would perish within the thunderstorms.

His own intention was not to succeed in a single blow and eliminate his great nemesis, Tony, right here and now. Although he was quite confident in his own strength, he was not so arrogant as to think that.

Although in some respects, Tieling could completely toy with Qin De, even a cornered rabbit will bite, let alone someone like Qin De who was not weak to begin with.

However, that was obviously not an easy task. The Lakers' situation was more complicated than imagined, and tackling it was not so simple.

Lin Nan had already consumed a significant amount of soul power in the two previous pill refinements, and now the Ten Staffs Breaking the Limit was a martial killing move that consumed immense energy. Even a prodigy like him could not help but gasp for breath.

For this competition for the ranking of hidden families, Luo Hai had already bet everything on Lin Nan.

During the tense life-or-death struggle, there was naturally no opportunity, but while aligning their thoughts in the cabin, and as the plane descended with ILS guidance, Yang Fan did not forget this point.

This time was even better. He kept saying he had no intention of competing with Qihang, that he would be happy just to gain a foothold in casual games… but what would happen after he gained that foothold?

As a survivor, Xiao Tang did not have the courage to become an adventurer. She had now applied for a job and was employed at a food processing company.

Finally arriving in the big city, Yu Chen was like a country bumpkin seeing the city for the first time, constantly looking around. In his state of absolute excitement and agitation, Yu Chen was completely unaware that he had bumped into another player.

While Ancestor Piaomiao was healing, within the Lu family estate in the same city, the Ten Thousand Poisons Sect had been searching for an entire night. To capture this Purple Spirit Immortal Gu, all the mortals within a ten-thousand-zhang radius of the Lu family home had been driven away. Surrounding the Lu family's courtyard walls, the Master of the Ten Thousand Poisons Sect had set up twelve large nets.

Perhaps because this was the second time for Huo Jun and Xiahou Yun, they were naturally prepared, and Huo Yu had already been reminded by a whisper from Xiahou Yun before entering the cave, so he did not feel it was too surprising.

"Damn it, I'll stop absorbing! I'll stop!" The Heaven-Swallowing Lord showed a pained expression, let out a sneeze, and spat out the sky full of heavenly lightning, which made him feel a bit better.

Bai Niu said angrily at this moment, "Fuck off, go home and harass your own mother. Don't think that just because you won a few first places at the sports meet, you're the only one who matters in the world. Let's go, let's ignore him!" After speaking, she pulled Hei Niu, turned around, and ran back.

"Hahaha, another Son of Creation sent to his death. Today is destined to be a bountiful day for me. All the Hearts of Creation will be mine." The Chaos Serpent King laughed boisterously. Seeing Yun Guo's Heart of Creation get blasted apart, he eagerly met the dragon-shaped golden light and swallowed it in one gulp.

"How could I be? Second Brother, I built my fortune from scratch. I'm a self-made man!" the old rogue boasted shamelessly.

However, just when he thought he was about to succeed, Huo Jun had to damn well return, and of all the rotten luck, he made it to the auction and called out a price that he couldn't possibly match. How could all of this not make him resentful?

He, Huo Yu, swore to the heavens that as long as he lived, he would treat the Qilin baby with extra kindness and regard it as his own. He believed Yun'er would do the same.
